analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: We may sell, share, rent, or otherwise disclose (we refer to these actions together as “share”) your Personal Information with the following categories of third parties: Subsidiaries and Affiliates... Service Providers... Business Partners... Advertising Partners... Advertisers...

analysis.headline: Shares Your Hashed Email
analysis.quote: For Advertising and Audience Matching: We may use information that you provide to us (e.g., your email address or other contact details) to reach people who are likely to be interested in our content or offerings. For example, we may share hashed (encrypted) contact information with platforms such as Google and Meta so they can help us show ads to people who have visited ourSite/Appor interacted with our content (“retargeting), find new audiences with similar interests (“lookalike” or “similar” audiences), and exclude current donors or newsletter subscribers from certain promotional campaigns (“suppression” or “anti-targeting”).

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Location Data, such as approximate location inferred from IP address or geographic location of your mobile device if you have consented to location services generally through your device’s settings or accepted our request for geolocation access. Your device location may be transmitted to us whenever our Service’s app is running (even if you are not actively using the app or it is running in the background on your device).

analysis.headline: Collects Your Friends' Data
analysis.quote: Our Services may include features that allow you to submit third-party Personal Information to us or otherwise allow us to automatically access third-party Personal Data in your possession. For example, our donation functionality may allow you to share a donation link with family and friends by providing us access to Personal Information such as names, email addresses, and phone numbers of your family and friends (together, we refer to this information as “Third-Party Data”).

analysis.headline: Collects Your Other Website Activity
analysis.quote: Information about Your Activity on Other Websites or Services. We may use information provided by third-party partners about your interaction with websites or services operated by or on behalf of such third parties. This information is sometimes referred to as “second-party data.”

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Clicks & Scrolls
analysis.quote: We use JavaScript and similar scripting languages to collect data about how you interact with our Services, such as mouse clicks, scrolling behavior, and page visits.

analysis.headline: Uses Identifiers for Ads
analysis.quote: To Create and Use Identifiers: To generate identifiers (such as hashed versions of your email address) or first-party identifiers to help deliver, suppress, or personalize advertising. These identifiers may be shared with Business Partners and Service Providers, such as Google and Meta, in connection with our advertising efforts, subject to applicable laws.

analysis.headline: Uses Numerous Tracking Technologies
analysis.quote: When you use our Services, we and our Service Providers and Business Partners may use Tracking Technologies to provide you with a more personalized experience, improve functionality, deliver relevant ads, and better understand how our Services are used. Below is a summary of the types of Tracking Technologies we use and how they may be applied: Cookies... Pixels... Software Development Kits (SDKs)... JavaScript... Identifiers... Local Storage and HTML5.

analysis.headline: Uses Your Submitted Content
analysis.quote: User Content and Feedback, such as information or content that you submit to us, including comments, photos, videos, audio, and text, whether submitted through online forms or social media platforms, by email, by phone, by mail, in surveys, or otherwise.
